error.summary: The prior source and shortcut defects are repaired, but valid comma-separated matrix indices fail native grading in the delivered batch. Package unchanged; no generated stored-pool defect demonstrated.

source_analysis.skill: Locate a highlighted matrix entry and express its one-based row and column in index notation.
reasoning_steps: Count its row from the top and column from the left.
Select or enter the indexed symbol, or enter the two indices separately.
invariants: The first index denotes row; the second denotes column.
Matrix label, answer and explanation agree.
permitted_variations: Vary highlighted positions, small matrix dimensions and labels.
Vary correct-choice roles within recognizable answer banks.
Change incidental entry values while preserving coordinate answers.
source_refs: Tutorial 34f3a63d-a273-50fb-b26a-ae172c7e93e9: first subscript represents row; second represents column.
Tutorial 775ac64e-8b63-5c51-824d-1d99d17a2a0a: indices range over valid rows and columns.

findings.description: Symbolic matrix-entry blanks reject valid comma-separated indices. The delivered batch accepts c_{22} but rejects c_{2,2}, although both identify its highlighted row-2, column-2 entry. The indexed-symbol parser treats the comma as a different formal symbol instead of recognizing equivalent matrix coordinates.
